item.description:
Lectern 1.3.0

Summarise files from your Mac, not just links

Added

  • “Notes from a link” now takes files from your Mac too: click Choose File… (several at once), drag files from Finder onto the bar, or paste a file's path. PDF, PowerPoint, Word, text and web-page files are summarised into notes at the bottom of the page, and a copy is kept in the subject's _attachments folder.

Lectern 1.2.0

Flashcards saved in pages, Summarise Subject with PDF export, and clearer Ollama setup

Added

  • **Summarise Subject…** in a subject's ⋯ menu (under Glossary): reads every page in the subject and writes a brief summary of the important content (overview, topic by topic, key terms, how ideas connect, focus for the exam) to a “📋 Subject Summary” page you can edit. Large subjects are summarised in parts, so it works with local Ollama models too.
  • **Export Summary as PDF…** in the subject's ⋯ menu (under Archive Subject): exports the finished summary as a PDF with a cover page.
  • Flashcards you make from a page are also saved in that page, in a “🃏 Flashcards” section: each card is a toggle (click the question to see the answer), with a link to the deck where they're studied. This covers AI-generated cards, “Make flashcard” from highlighted text and New Flashcard from a page.
  • An “Open Ollama” button in Settings → AI and on AI errors when Ollama isn't running on your Mac.

Fixed

  • When the chosen Ollama server (for example ollama.com) doesn't have the selected model, Settings → AI now says so and offers “Use Local (this Mac)”, and the error names the server instead of saying the model is missing.

Lectern 1.1.0

Ollama support, sidebar ⋯ menus, notes from a link, and a formatting toolbar with comments

Added

  • Ollama as an AI provider (Settings → AI), like Atlas's Local mode: use free models running on your Mac (localhost:11434), or Ollama's hosted models at ollama.com with an Ollama API key kept in the Keychain. Every AI feature works with it; models that can see images also explain diagram slides. Onboarding offers “Use Ollama instead”.
  • A ⋯ button on subjects and folders in the sidebar (and on pages when you point at them) with New Page, New Folder, Rename, Duplicate, Move, Show in Finder, Export and Move to Trash, so you don't need to right-click.
  • “Notes from a link” on every page: paste a link to an article, PDF, PowerPoint, Word file or Google Doc (or open one in Lectern's browser if it needs your iLearn login), and the AI adds a summary, key points, notes, key terms and questions to the bottom of the page. The link is saved in the page's sources.
  • A formatting toolbar above every page: text style (Text, Title, Heading 1–3, Quote, Code), font size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text colour, highlight colour, links, comments, lists and undo/redo. Underline and Comment are also in the selection toolbar.
  • Comments: select text and add a note to it; click the text to read, edit or resolve the comment. Comments, colours and sizes are saved in the Markdown, so they survive opening the page elsewhere.
  • Settings → Appearance can hide the formatting toolbar.

Fixed

  • Lectern now always opens its main window when it starts, even if the window was closed when you last quit.
